scope: Seminar software workflow and source-supported published content. This is not clinical validation or complete leaflet-warning coverage.
remainingLimits: Short explanations do not cover all leaflet warnings: Anti-phen omits the separate precautions/overdose fields; the selected Bubdel explanation summarizes only part of usage precautions. Full cited text and the original leaflet remain available.
Only one of the six selected learning records includes a warning quiz; the other five assess purpose only.
Secorine public-photo transcription was checked, but flavor/variant identity and official multi-column text remain unresolved; its full explanation/quiz flow is not accepted.
Only two original public historical photographs were used. Physical phones, new lighting/blur conditions and HEIC images are not covered. HEIC is explicitly rejected.
Bubdel uses a fully reviewed manual transcription; automatic scanned/multi-column leaflet extraction is not generally solved.
evidencePolicy: Sanitized aggregate only. Raw reports, local account and medication records, photos, downloaded PDFs, environment files and credentials are excluded from Git. Original evidence remains in the tested workspace; this summary alone does not independently reproduce it.
